A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. One row, sqlite ext/intck/sqlite3intck.c:936 MEM30-C, first labelled FP by precision_audit_b14 with the basis "p->zTestSql freed then reassigned each branch single free per call no double-free".

THE BASIS IS TRUE OF TWO OF THE THREE BRANCHES AND NOT THE THIRD. sqlite3_intck_test_sql frees p->zTestSql at line 929 and then branches: zObj non-NULL reassigns at 931; zObj NULL with p->zObj non-NULL reassigns at 934; zObj NULL and p->zObj NULL reaches line 936, which frees p->zTestSql a second time with nothing assigning to it in between. The prior reason generalises the reassignment across all three arms, which is where it goes wrong. The second free is a no-op only when p->zTestSql was already NULL on entry.

READ AT SOURCE in the pinned checkout (b1a73ba34d05, corpus-check clean, all 12 trees detached at their pins) on dev-149, independently of the reviews recorded in bmdb 1449.
